user.title: Configure Smart Charger Socket
user.description: Select the switch controlling the socket and the sensor measuring its power draw.

device.title: Add Device to Charger
device.description: Configure smart devices (phones, watches, tablets) that can be plugged into this charger. Currently added: {device_count} devices. Leave empty to finish.

force_100.name: Force 100% Charge
force_100.description: Force charging socket on until 100% is reached.

stop.name: Stop Charging
stop.description: Immediately stop charging and turn off the socket.
